evidence: A calculation on products: the drainage network study's routing of the climate run on the final surface (sunlight 0.930, years 35-49, 300.3 K at the ground), carried from its settled turned frame onto today's ground, over the redrawn floor with the works chosen on 16 November, each weir set by routing again until the sea it serves receives its need. The cuts' routes are found between 1.9 km cells. Not validated against any observation.
reading_rule: As governed_drainage.json: levels in m above the redrawn common level, flows in m3/s, areas in km2; cases on the routing's own budget and on the one its open-water evaporation factor closes. design_state_without_the_works is the same climate with the upper seas spilling over their natural passes and no weirs or cuts. against_the_present_climate pairs each number as [present design climate at 8 degrees, this run]. routing names each budget's governed routing on the research drive.
